Subject: Eval gateway & promptset onboarding: QMon sandbox planning

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to move forward with Redwood for the quality monitoring (QMon) rollout. To make the sandbox workshop productive, our goals are:
- Align on prompt sets and baseline expectations
- Wire up the eval harness (test -> eval -> alert) to your staging endpoint
- Agree canary & rollback policy for model swaps and prompt changes
- Define regression alert thresholds and on-call steps

Can you confirm the following before our workshop:
1) A staging/test endpoint or sample payloads we can call (no PHI in the samples unless we have a BAA in place)
2) Who should be in the demo (engineering + product or just implementation?)
3) Any required security docs for our infra access (I'll attach the MAP we discussed)

Proposed time: Wed Mar 13, 10:00–10:45 PT — 30 min demo + 15 min action items.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP_v0.xlsx) with proposed milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into the sandbox.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 12 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Eval gateway & promptset onboarding: QMon sandbox planning

Team — quick internal plan so we can go into Wed's workshop aligned. Key asks from Novamed: staging access + security checklist (they sent the PDF). Proposed ownership:
- Marissa: lead prompt-set curation and fallback prompt library (baseline prompts for clinical flows)
- Karthik: eval harness integration + metrics mapping, will prepare the GitHub repo and webhook for result callbacks
- Laura: telemetry, SLO/alert definitions, dashboard templates for SLA and regression tracking

Proposed canary policy (draft):
- Canary traffic: 10% of sandbox traffic initially, ramp to 25% after 24 hours if no regressions
- Observation window: 48 hours (per Novamed request)
- Automatic rollback trigger: >2% relative regression on primary accuracy metric OR any P0 correctness failures in clinical prompts
- Manual rollback: immediate if SRE flags a production risk

Please review and reply with edits. I'll present this to Novamed and record any exceptions. Attaching an internal_playbook.md stub with the day-of checklist.

Thanks,
Steph
[attachment: internal_playbook.md (text)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 12 Mar 2028 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Eval gateway & promptset onboarding: QMon sandbox planning

Agree with the plan. A couple quick additions from prompt curation side:
- We'll include a fallback prompt set and a labeled baseline (gold) set for regression comparisons; need Novamed to share 1k de-identified examples for baseline creation.
- Please confirm the metric surface: accuracy, top-k correctness, hallucination rate (manual labels), latency percentiles (p50/p95).
- Suggest we add a pre-canary smoke run of 200 prompts to validate the eval hook and label mapping.

I'll prepare the baseline prompt scaffold today and drop into the repo.

- Marissa
Senior Customer Success Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: RE: Eval gateway & promptset onboarding: QMon sandbox planning

All — I've created the repo and an eval harness template: https://github.com/redwood-inference/novamed-eval-harness
Integration notes:
- We'll use the webhook endpoint to push eval results back into our telemetry pipeline (payload schema is in the README).
- Recommend a 1k prompt batch for the first full regression baseline; do a 200-prompt smoke test during Wed's workshop.
- For latency-sensitive clinical prompts, we'll enable smaller batch sizes and per-request routing to keep p95 under your SLA.

I'll be on the workshop call to walk through the repo + demo the smoke run.

— Karthik
Applied ML / Inference Eng
Redwood Inference

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks for the quick alignment. Recap and next steps so everyone has a single source of truth:
1) Workshop: Wed Mar 15, 10:00–10:45 PT (30 min workshop + 15 min actions) — invite sent.
2) Pre-work (Novamed): provide staging account + 1k de-identified sample prompts by EOD Tue Mar 14 (I see Priya is sending the staging creds Monday — please accelerate if possible).
3) Redwood deliverables before workshop:
   - Marissa: baseline prompt set + fallback library (drop in repo)
   - Karthik: eval harness smoke script (200 prompts) and webhook config
   - Laura: telemetry dashboard template + initial alert thresholds (will bring SLO draft)

5) Post-workshop: run full 1k regression baseline and confirm regression alert thresholds, then schedule canary rollout to pre-prod.

Attachments: MAP_v0.xlsx (draft), internal_playbook.md (day-of checklist). I'll upload the signed MAP after we agree in the workshop.
